title: Weight invariance on already fixed coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each coordinate in $[n]$, let $L$ be a list of distinct coordinates, and let $x$ be a binary vector of length $n$. If every coordinate in $L$ is already fixed in $\rho$, then fixing those coordinates according to the signs encoded by $x$ leaves the weight of $\rho$ unchanged.
